app "Basketball" ball slate
table point team pick Team_A|Team_B, pts num 1..500 = 1
let a = sum(point.pts where team = Team_A)
let b = sum(point.pts where team = Team_B)
setting winat num = 50 "Play to"

  stack card grow align center
    "Team A" bold
    a big
    button "+1" tap add point team = Team_A, pts = 1

      button "+10" tap add point team = Team_A, pts = 10
  stack card grow align center
    "Team B" bold
    b big
    button "+1" tap add point team = Team_B, pts = 1
    row gap 1
      button "+10" tap add point team = Team_B, pts = 10
button "Undo" tap remove last(point)
button "New game" tap remove all point

if b >= winat

- a button "+10"; a tap adds a point with team set to Team A, pts set to 10.
- text: "Team B".
- text: b.
- a button "+1"; a tap adds a point with team set to Team B, pts set to 1.
- a button "+10"; a tap adds a point with team set to Team B, pts set to 10.
- a button "Undo"; a tap removes the latest point entries, with undo.

program:
app "Score Keeper Pro" ball ocean
table ball runs num 0..6 = 0, wide bool, out bool
setting overs num = 20
let legal = count(ball today where wide = no)
let runs = sum(ball.runs today) + count(ball today where wide = yes)
let wkts = count(ball today where out = yes)
runs "/" wkts big
"Overs" floor(legal / 6) + legal % 6 / 10 "of" overs ". Run rate" round(runs * 6 / legal) faint
row gap 1
  each [0, 1, 2, 3, 4, 6]
    button it tap add ball runs = it
row gap 1
  button "Wide" tap add ball wide = yes
  button "Out" fill bad tap add ball out = yes
  button "Undo" tap remove last(ball today)
row gap 1
  each ball today sort at desc top 6
    draw width 36
      circle 50, 50, 46 fill if(it.out, bad, if(it.runs >= 4, good, soft))
      if it.out
        label 50, 50, "W" bold
      else
        label 50, 50, it.runs bold
describe:
Score Keeper Pro, in the ocean colours.
Keeps:
- ball: runs: number, 0 to 6, starts at 0; wide: yes or no; out: yes or no. Every entry also keeps when it was added.
You can change: overs: number, starts at 20.
Works out:
- legal is how many ball entries today where wide is no.
- runs is the total runs of ball today plus how many ball entries today where wide is yes.
- wkts is how many ball entries today where out is yes.
Shows:
- text: runs, "/", wkts.
- text: "Overs", legal divided by 6 rounded down plus legal leaves over when divided by 6 divided by 10, "of", overs, ". Run rate", runs times 6 divided by legal rounded.
- for 0, 1, 2, 3, 4, 6:
  - a button the value; a tap adds a ball with runs set to the value.
- a button "Wide"; a tap adds a ball with wide set to yes.
- a button "Out"; a tap adds a ball with out set to yes.
- a button "Undo"; a tap removes the latest ball entries today, with undo.
- for each ball today sorted by at, highest first, first 6:
  - a drawing made of circles, labels.

app "Sleep diary" bed mint
table night bed time, asleep time, woke time, rested num 1..5 = 3
"Average sleep, this week" faint
sum(night week, (it.woke - it.asleep)) / count(night week) big
"Rested by weekday (lowest is worst)" head
each ["Mon", "Tue", "Wed", "Thu", "Fri", "Sat", "Sun"] as w
  row
    w grow color if(count(night where weekday(at) = index + 1) > 0 and avg(night.rested where weekday(at) = index + 1) = min(1..7, if(count(night where weekday(at) = it) > 0, avg(night.rested where weekday(at) = it), 5)), bad, ink)
    round(avg(night.rested where weekday(at) = index + 1) * 10) / 10 "of 5"
form night
list night by day
describe:
Sleep diary, in the mint colours.
Keeps:
- night: bed: time of day; asleep: time of day; woke: time of day; rested: number, 1 to 5, starts at 3. Every entry also keeps when it was added.
Shows:
- text: "Average sleep, this week".
- text: the sum of the result of its woke minus its asleep over the night this week divided by how many night entries this week.
- text: "Rested by weekday (lowest is worst)".
- for "Mon", "Tue", "Wed", "Thu", "Fri", "Sat", "Sun":
  - text: the value.
  - text: the average rested of night where the weekday number of at is its position plus 1 times 10 rounded divided by 10, "of 5".
- a form to add a night.
- a list of night by day; tap one to edit it, swipe to remove it.
